locator.name: stacks Operations at 40rem without gutters and restores the stored rail widths above it

proves.facet: With stubbed 40rem media and stored 430px/250px rail widths, the shell has one track in narrow mode, restores 430px/minmax380/250px tracks above it, and leaves stored widths unchanged; this is a DOM/style assertion, not browser geometry.

1.note: Mounted CockpitShell with synthetic matchMedia asserts one-column ASIDE/MAIN/ASIDE, hidden gutters, narrow CSS classes and restoration/preservation of stored 430/250 rail widths above 40rem. CSS class/inline-style assertions are not real 390px overflow measurements.
